title: AgentQ Deploy Plan
description: The artifact produced by `agentq state plan` and consumed by `agentq state apply` plus agentq-actions' PR-comment + step-summary renderers. This file is the cross-repo integration contract: every field is referenced by either the CLI's apply path or the action's render scripts. Adding a field is non-breaking; renaming or removing a field is a major-version bump on both sides.

schema_version.description: Plan schema version. Increment requires a major-version bump in BOTH agentq-cli and agentq-actions, with a migration entry in each repo's CHANGELOG.

plan_id.description: Stable identifier for this plan instance, used to label PR comments and artifacts. Format: '<tier>-<short-sha>-<unix-ts>'.

generated_by.description: User email or service account email — whoever ran `agentq state plan`.

source_sha.description: git HEAD when plan was computed. Apply step compares against current HEAD; mismatch is informational, not fatal.

project_name.description: From agentq.config.yaml::project.name — the canonical key for state lookup. NOT the GitHub repo name.

display_name.description: Composed display name (project.display_name + tier.display_name_suffix). Used for log messages and PR comments.

mode.description: What will happen to the Reasoning Engine. 'no_op' = config matches state exactly. 'create' = no engine yet. 'update' = engine exists, config drift detected. 'recreate' = a field changed that requires destroying and rebuilding (e.g. region change).

resource_name.description: Existing engine resource name. Null when mode=create. Echoed back as the apply step's output.

config_hash_before.description: Hash from state.yaml. Null on first deploy.

config_hash_after.description: Hash computed from local source. Apply step verifies this still matches at execution time; mismatch = drift, apply aborts.

config_diff.description: Field-by-field diff. Empty when mode=no_op. PR comment renders the user-facing subset.

field.description: Dotted path into the config, e.g. 'runtime.model' or 'tiers.prod.labels.env'.

requires_recreate.description: When true, this change forces engine_plan.mode=recreate.

action.description: 'skip' = tier policy says no KB mutation (e.g. staging without override). 'no_op' = nothing changed. 'reimport' = mutations queued.

datastore_created_by_plan.description: True on the first deploy when the datastore doesn't exist yet and we'll create it. Distinguishes a brand-new corpus from an updated one in the PR comment.

detected.description: True when the deployed reality differs from what state.yaml says it should be — e.g. someone deleted the engine in the console, or a KB document was removed out-of-band.

details.description: Human-readable lines describing each drift event.

state_generation.description: GCS object generation of the state.yaml this plan was computed against. apply step asserts the current generation still matches; if not, a concurrent deploy happened and we abort with a clear error. Null = state file didn't exist when plan was computed (first deploy).

risks.description: Optional advisory items the PR comment surfaces in a 'Risk markers' section. Not blocking — drift gating + tier policy are the actual gates.

field.description: Optional dotted path the risk pertains to.

document_id.description: Gemini Enterprise Search Document.name leaf. Present for changed/removed/unchanged. Absent for added (assigned on import).
